purpose: Teach: 夢想/貪欲/空虚/アクシデント/を通じまして/うねり/交わり/地平線

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人の夢想じみた動機を、警察、慎重に分析されますね
lines.en: The police will likely analyze this suspect's almost delusional motive with considerable care, wouldn't you say?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful pace. Slight formal register — academic but not cold. Soft questioning lift at the end, inviting agreement rather than asserting it. Quiet respect in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の遺品から貪欲な収集癖を読み取られますね
lines.en: The police did read a pattern of possessive collecting habits from the victim's belongings, yes.
lines.style: Calm, cooperative tone. Straightforward delivery without defensiveness. Patient — acknowledging Ren's point while adding the next layer. Even pacing, grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の空虚感の背景を、警察、心理士と確認されますね
lines.en: The police will want to confirm the background of the victim's sense of emptiness with a psychologist, I imagine.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Slight pause before the second clause — gathering the thought. Respectful of the complexity. Soft affirmation seeking at the end, not demanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場のアクシデント記録も詳しく取られますね
lines.en: The police are being thorough about documenting all the incident details from the scene.
lines.style: Straightforward, professional. Affirming tone. Even delivery showing steady methodical work. No flourish — just factual agreement, warm in its solidity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ご協力を通じまして得た情報を、警察、慎重に活用されますね
lines.en: Through this cooperation, the information we've gathered—the police will handle that with appropriate caution, of course.
lines.style: Careful, measured. Slight hesitation before 'we've gathered' — acknowledging the shared weight of responsibility. Respectful pace. Trailing softly on the closing phrase.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の世論のうねりにも対応されますね
lines.en: The police are also navigating the public attention this investigation has drawn.
lines.style: Even, composed. Acknowledging the complexity without strain. Professional cadence — matter-of-fact about the pressure without minimizing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者と被害者の交わりの履歴を、警察、調べられますね
lines.en: The police will need to examine the history of contact between the suspect and victim.
lines.style: Reflective, slower pace. Careful enunciation showing the importance of this point. Collaborative tone — not challenging, but laying out what still needs to be understood together.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地平線の彼方からの密航事案も対応されますね
lines.en: The police are also handling the complications from the smuggling case that came across the border.
lines.style: Calm, accepting tone. Slight shift — acknowledging this as an unexpected complication but one they're managing. Even pacing, professional composure.
